approved: Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Amendment (Regulatory Powers and Other Measures) Bill 2014
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill fixes technical problems so that earlier offshore petroleum laws can start working properly.
It links the start of key compliance measures to a new regulatory powers act and adds a rule for refunding annual title levies when a title ends early.
The bill also removes a specific infringement notice power and corrects minor errors in the main Act.
Links commencement of Schedules 1 and 2 of the Compliance Measures No. 1 Act to the proposed Regulatory Powers (Standard Provisions) Act 2014.
Adds a regulation-making power to allow refund or remittal of annual titles administration levy if a title ends before the year is up.
Stops the regulator from issuing an infringement notice for failing to have an operator's representative always present at a facility.
Updates section 343 for consistency with similar provisions.
Removes the need to provide a copy of the application for certain approvals.
Fixes a missing subsection number and outdated references in section 649.
Companies holding offshore petroleum titles and the regulator responsible for monitoring them.
